description: This file defines a Flutter widget called TransactionCard, which visually represents a financial transaction with details like amount, category, note, and date. It imports models for category and transaction, as well as a currency formatter utility, and uses Flutter's material components to construct the UI.

classes.name: TransactionCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays transaction details like amount, category, note, and date in a card format.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for the transaction card, displaying transaction details and category icon.

methods.name: _formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

methods.name: _two
methods.description: Ensures month and day are two digits by adding a leading zero if necessary.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Returns an appropriate icon based on the category's icon name.
